newsitem.title: USA: Uno sees Q2 earnings of $0.06 to $0.07.
newsitem.headline: Uno sees Q2 earnings of $0.06 to $0.07.

text.p: Uno Restaurant Corp said on Wednesday it expects to report earnings per share for the second quarter of $0.06 to $0.07, and in the $0.50 to $0.55 range for full-year fiscal 1997.
Uno's second quarter ends March 30. In last year's second quarter, Uno had a loss of $0.21 per share. For full-year fiscal 1996 it reported a profit of $0.13 per share.
Uno also said its same-store sales for January were up 3.7 percent compared with the same period in 1996, and average-unit sales increased 5.4 percent.
But the company also said that that sluggish sales in the casual dining industry remain troublesome.

"In our view, the obvious strategy in an increasingly competitive industry is to continually adapt to the preferences of our guests," Uno President Craig Miller said in a statement released by the company.
